page.layout: One printed plate (folded engraving) filling the page: a large circular diagram with concentric circles and radial lines, with letter labels around the rim and centre. Mirrored show-through text in the corners. Edge of the facing page at the right.
page.notes: The page carries an engraved diagram of concentric circles with radial divisions, a centre circle and labels around the rim and inside the circles, but these labels are faint and I cannot read them reliably, so I have not transcribed them. The handwriting and printed-looking script in the corners and lower right is show-through mirrored from the other side of the leaf, not text on this page. The strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. There is no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
